name: Ichiro Sakaki
source:
As deputy director, Ichiro is the oldest in the lab and a reliable researcher on the island. Well-like and respected by the teammates. He is also the life and soul of the team. The bitter experience he had in his childhood made him a researcher, to protect and preserve the island and save the country. Ichiro always takes the lead and solved a number of mysterious incidents. Is he the kind of man you are looking for?

Favorites: Chocolate, he has a sweet tooth.
Dislikes: Mantis
Hobby: Research and Golf
Skill: Kendo and Calligraphy.
